pages.text: Reads the signal strength of a pressure plate.$(br2)Pressure plates can only be read; entities press them. A block that is not a pressure plate raises INVALID_ARGUMENT. An empty $(1)dimension$() in the position means the dimension of the trigger block.
$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the pressure plate is$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: the signal strength, 0 to 15
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/GET_PRESSURE_PLATE$(br)  PARAMETER position plate ;$(br)  RESULT result strength$()
